input.quote: Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: No audit, inspection or fee-verification right runs against Clear Capital anywhere in this time-and-materials consulting agreement. Searches for audit, inspection, verification, records, books, monitoring and on-site or premises review returned nothing binding Company, and Sections 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 contain no such right. Fees are substantiated only by Contractor-supplied invoice detail under Section 3(b), not by any examination of our records or systems. The single access-related provision (Section 1(c), p0007) runs in our favour, requiring Contractor personnel to comply with our security and computer-system access policies. Because no audit right binds Customer, the frequency, notice, cost-allocation and no-system-access limits have nothing to attach to and the rule is satisfied by absence; we do not volunteer an audit right in order to qualify it, since that would weaken us. No redline proposed.
